title: CoreBoost
body:
# CoreBoost 
Experience Minecraft at its absolute peak.
Tired of stuttering and low frames? This pack is the ultimate lightweight optimization solution for Minecraft 1.21.11. Built on the high-performance Fabric loader, this collection strips away engine inefficiencies to deliver a butter-smooth, high-FPS experience.
Why This Pack?
Designed for creators and survivalists alike, this stack removes bottlenecks to ensure maximum stability. We have curated the most essential performance mods to give you the highest frame rates possible without compromising the vanilla feel.
## Core Enhancements:
**Rendering Power:** Replaces the engine with **Sodium** and boosts entity processing with **ImmediatelyFast.**
**Logic & Physics:** Optimizes game logic and network performance with **Lithium** and **Krypton** to eliminate micro-stutters.
**Memory Efficiency:** Drastically lowers your RAM footprint using ,*FerriteCore.,,
**Smart Resource Usage:** Includes **Dynamic FPS** to save power when minimized and **Entity Culling** to stop rendering hidden objects.
**Fast Chunking:** Dramatically improves loading speeds with **C2ME.**
## Quick Setup
**Requirements:** Install **Fabric Loader (1.21.11)** and **Fabric API.**
**Configuration:** Use **Mod Menu** and **Cloth Config API** (included) to tweak settings in-game.
**RAM:** We recommend allocating **4GB–6GB** for the best performance.
_Built for speed. Built for stability._
